questionText:

questionText:
Match the knockout fixture formula in List I with its calculation in List II (for N teams):

List I:
(A) Total Matches
(B) Total Byes (where P is next power of 2)
(C) Teams in Upper Half (if N is odd)
(D) Teams in Lower Half (if N is odd)

List II:
(I) N - 1
(II) P - N
(III) (N + 1) / 2
(IV) (N - 1) / 2

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.text: A-I, B-III, C-IV, D-II
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: A-IV, B-II, C-I, D-III
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: A-I, B-II, C-III, D-IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the verified NCERT principle for Knockout Formulas.

options.text: A-II, B-I, C-III, D-IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Yoga and Yogic Practices (Knockout Formulas):
A-I, B-II, C-III, D-IV

Detailed Analysis:
Matches = N - 1; Byes = P - N; Upper Half = (N + 1)/2; Lower Half = (N - 1)/2.
Therefore, option (C) is the correct answer.
